6 تخالعوا (tropical:) They annulled, dissolved, or broke, the confederacy, league, compact, or covenant, that was between them. (S, * K, * TA.) ―
-b2- تَخَالَعَا (tropical:) They divorced themselves, namely, a husband and his wife, for a gift, or a compensation, (بِبَذْلٍ, or بِبَدَلٍ, accord. to different copies of the S,) from the wife to the husband. (S.) See also خَلَعَ ٱمْرَأَتَهُ.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
